spine.label: Layout
spine.note: How the moments sit along the line. On a phone they stack down one side of it, whichever you pick.

centre.label: Either side of the line
centre.note: The moments alternate left and right of a line down the middle on a wide screen. The default.

start.label: All on one side
start.note: Every moment on one side of a line at the left, on every screen.

photos.label: Photographs
photos.note: Whether the moments show their photographs.

with.label: With photographs
with.note: A photograph beside each moment that has one; a moment without one is its words alone. The default.

without.label: Words only
without.note: Dates, titles and lines only, with no photographs, even for moments that have one.

ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind this section. Change it between one section and the next.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint, to separate this section from the one above.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor reaches it, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: Each moment eases in as the visitor scrolls to it. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
